remnote.why: RemNote's own plugins. Best reference for how Why Loop, Bubble Map and Feynman Coach should be structured before they go public.
Official starter template. Diff your plugins against it to catch drift in build config and manifest.
Community plugin pack. Active Recall in Editor and Callout are the two worth trying for Why Loop pages.
Running index of RemNote plugins, themes and CSS. Check here first before building something new.

spaced-repetition.why: Index of everything built on FSRS, the scheduler RemNote uses.
FSRS in TypeScript. Drop-in scheduler if Why Loop or Pattern Academy ever needs its own review timing.
Fits FSRS parameters to your real review history. Use once you have a few months of Why Loop cards.
Open source local-first macOS flashcard app on FSRS. Reference build for MCAT Pattern Academy.

claude-skills.why: Anthropic's official skills. The source of truth for how a skill should be written.
Curated skill list with a Skills vs MCP explainer.
Largest curated skill list, grouped by category.
Skills, hooks, slash commands and plugins for Claude Code.

mcp-servers.why: Official MCP server collection. Filesystem, git, fetch and more.
Connects a Zotero library to Claude with semantic search and PDF annotations. Fits Priolo lab reading and thesis citations.

diagrams.why: Official Excalidraw MCP. Already connected in Claude, so this is here for reference.
Persistent live canvas Claude can edit across turns. Upgrade path if one-shot diagrams aren't enough.
